blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – A parish in M’lang, Cotabato, has suspended all Masses and sacramental celebrations inside its main church after a break-in that resulted in the desecration of the Blessed Sacrament that is kept in the tabernacle. The Sta. Teresita del Niño Jesus Parish, in an announcement, expressed profound sorrow over the incident, saying the desecration had deeply wounded the faith and the parish community. The parish said all Masses and sacramental celebrations inside the main church would remain suspended until the Rite of Reparation is solemnly celebrated.
